# Parity Source Precedence

The active root and production behavior govern conflicts, while archived code supplies preserved
capability evidence that must be reconciled rather than copied blindly.

## What Happened

In SALUS Pramana task t1, the rewrite scope included both a newer active-root application and an
archived monorepo. The constitution fixed source precedence and defined parity as a complete
requirement-to-design-to-task-to-test evidence chain.

## Takeaway

Future discovery and planning tasks must inventory both sources, preserve every active-root
capability, and restore archived-only capabilities without regressing newer root behavior. A
passing build, visual similarity, or unchecked requirement is not parity.
